title: C-77, a permanent ban, and 6.18's packet log and .network commands in one run
notes: The account is banned for an hour before its first sign-in, then permanently, and each refusal's dialog is shot with the end the client reads from TimeStamp.
The login server's packet log is on from the start, so the refused authentication shows the named, redacted MSG_USER_AUTHEN_V3 line.
Unbanned and made an administrator, the wizard enters the Commons, asks .network sessions, then clears the suppress list and filters the packet log
to MSG_CLIENTMOVE from chat, and the next step it walks is logged by name with no restart.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
ban the account for an hour before its first sign-in
submit the hour-banned account's password
the server refuses the hour-banned account
steps.pattern: failed to authenticate as {user}: the account is banned; sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_RSP Error=(\S+)

steps.name: the client receives a non-success response (hour-banned)
the client chooses a refusal message (hour-banned)
the client shows the hour-banned ban and when it ends
the packet log names the authentication message and redacts its fields
ban the account permanently
quit the client and start it again for the permanent ban
the client brings its renderer up again for the permanent ban
the login window is on the screen again for the permanent ban
submit the permanently banned account's password
the server refuses the permanently banned account
steps.pattern: failed to authenticate as {user}: the account is banned; sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_RSP Error=(\S+)

steps.name: the client receives a non-success response (permanently banned)
the client chooses a refusal message (permanently banned)
the client shows the permanently banned ban and when it ends
lift the bans
make the account a game master
quit the client and start it again to play
the client brings its renderer up again to play
the login window is on the screen again to play
log in
the server accepts the password
the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
the game server puts the wizard in the Commons

steps.name: the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: open the chat line to type .network sessions
take out the slash the key writes before .network sessions
type .network sessions
send .network sessions
the game server answers .network sessions

steps.name: the game master reads the live session count
walk while MSG_CLIENTMOVE is suppressed
open the chat line to type .network packetlog suppress
take out the slash the key writes before .network packetlog suppress
type .network packetlog suppress
send .network packetlog suppress
the suppress list is cleared live
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran network packetlog suppress, which worked

steps.name: open the chat line to type .network packetlog filter MSG_CLIENTMOVE
take out the slash the key writes before .network packetlog filter MSG_CLIENTMOVE
type .network packetlog filter MSG_CLIENTMOVE
send .network packetlog filter MSG_CLIENTMOVE
the filter is set live
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran network packetlog filter MSG_CLIENTMOVE, which worked

steps.name: the game master reads the packet log replies
walk with the filter on MSG_CLIENTMOVE
the next move is logged by name without a restart
